scene: The brass key buzzes, activating three transit docks along the mist-draped plaza.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the level stone platform. On the far left sits a yellow winged flying scooter. Left of centre, Granny holds the glowing key beside her white dog. At centre, a wicker gondola drone floats beside a post. Far right, a sleek hover metro waits with open glowing doors.
shown: a yellow winged flying scooter idling on a striped pad on the far left
a striped wicker gondola drone tethered to a brass post at centre
a sleek hover metro with open doors at a platform on the far right
